## alice-dms-image-description-backfill

Manual backfill: retries the AI vision description for Weaviate "Image"
objects where extraction_failed = true (e.g. after an OLLAMA_URL outage).

**Trigger**: POST /webhook/alice-dms-image-description-backfill
**Processes**: Weaviate collection "Image" only, filter extraction_failed = true
**Leaves untouched**: weaviate_uuid, thumbnail_path, additionalPaths, EXIF and geocoding fields
**Progress**: logged as { processed, updated, still_failed, remaining }
**Safe to re-run**: extraction_failed = true filter automatically excludes already-fixed images

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $env.OLLAMA_VISION_MODEL, prompt: 'Beschreibe dieses Bild ausführlich auf Deutsch in 3-5 Sätzen. Beschreibe was du siehst: Personen, Objekte, Szene, Ort, Farben, Stimmung.', images: [$json.image_b64], stream: false, options: { temperature: 0.3 } }) }}
